newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Rotterdam bunkers rise $2, but volumes remain low.
newsitem.headline: Rotterdam bunkers rise $2, but volumes remain low.

text.p: Rotterdam fuel oil bunkers gained about $2 on Tuesday in line with barge gains, while prices in the rest of Europe wavered by about $1, dealers said.
Rotterdam bunkers were $2 a tonne firmer at around $87 fob after barges were pushed up by one major in particular. Traders suspected the major wished to benefit a large fuel oil sale.
Bunker demand was slight, again. The total volume of enquiries was under 10,000 tonnes.
Hamburg bunkers also headed higher with few buyers interested.
Mediterranean prices were mixed, but prices for fuel oil in most ports dipped.
"We're really very keen to shift product. That's why the prices are lower," one supplier said.
Egyptian prices barely changed. Supply in all ports was sufficient.
